title: alchemilla vulgaris proles obtusa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris proles obtusa, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including menstrual cramps, digestive problems, and skin irritations, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of lady's mantle include flavonoids, tannins, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
